segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment by Codex (English-first independent proposal); GMR English is verbatim. Mechanical generation does not establish semantic approval. The body-washing phrase is retained at d3 as "washes himself"; lus is not equated separately with "himself." "with the water" is supplied from context and remains unwrapped. The established expression blos rlom pa owns "imagination" without separate blo/rlom members. The second mi and its possessive construction are expressed pronominally and remain unbanked. The closing zer na and copular/conditional frame are distributed through the opening speech frame and the English clause, so are omitted rather than nulled.
